items.title: 66095_Benny Carter oral history interview
items.q: Roy Eldridge suggested we drive up to hear Speed Webb and Speed Webb had a very fine pianist that Roy thought I would like.

ctx.x: So, how did Teddy Wilson join -- it was this group that Teddy Wilson joined when he came to New York?

Yes, that was about 1933, when I had been playing with Fletcher sometime before then, we were playing a date in Providence, Rhode Island, and following that engagement that night, we had a night off. Roy Eldridge suggested we drive up to hear Speed Webb and Speed Webb had a very fine pianist that Roy thought I would like.
So we went up there, and I heard the pianist and I was just oh, tremendously impressed - and it was Teddy Wilson.
